claim_en: THE MIXTURE BANS. Mixture-only breeding; maintaining counts; the three-predicate shaatnez; wear and cover banned, the fence labeled fence.
THE MAIDSERVANT. Four readings; the document completes — Onkelos writes it in; she lashed he not; one offering many acts; deliberate as erring.
THE INTENT-DEFINED TREE. Fence-and-timber plantings exempt by intent; total benefit ban; thirty days = a year; the fourth year as tithe-holy.
THE BLESSING PEG. Praises = blessing before and after; taste nothing unblessed; Onkelos's holy-of-praises.
FIVE LAWS ON ONE CLAUSE. The executed court's fast among them; the time-setters as soothsaying.
THE RAZOR SOLVE. Shaving-with-destruction as the intersection; five corners; per-gash and per-dead; write-and-engrave both.
SANCTUARY YIELDS. The building never overrides Sabbath; awe of the Commander, forever; the protocol; the land straying to its fruits.

source: Sifra, Kedoshim, Chapter 7 12-15 + Chapter 8 1-4 + Onkelos Lev 19:32
claim_en: THE SCHOLAR ELDER. Acquired-wisdom parsing with Onkelos ruling it; reach and no-cost; the reciprocal duty; the convert's gate and geography.
MEASURES ARE JUDGMENT. The measurer-judge with five effects; the inspector and cleaning table; the tilt and surcharges; the Exodus condition.
